messages:
Evan: Quick ask — can someone run an initial onboarding benchmark for Yukon-8B v1.0? Seq lengths: 16/128/1024/2048, focus on seq128 single-token p99. Batch sweep 1,2,4,8. Use 4-bit quant for baseline. Need smoke + profiling and a quick cost/back-of-envelope. Target p99 < 450ms (batch=1, seq=128).

bench-bot: Scheduled run yukon-8b-v1.0-run-20260318-01 on dev-cluster-a (4xA100). ETA ~12m. Will post summary when complete.

Mara: I started the smoke now. Running the usual short+long prompt mix. Note: default kvcache tiling enabled — might see eviction noise at batch=8.

Sophia: If we care about chat latency, include a prefix-cache scenario (50% requests with 512 token prefix). I can add that to the run.

Evan: Yes please include prefix-cache. Also capture perf counters (l2 miss, cuda wait) and a flamegraph if possible.

bench-bot: Run finished. Summary: median single-token (seq128, batch1)=132ms, p95=280ms, p99=520ms. CPU side queuing observed during tail spikes. Full report: https://internal.artifacts/redwood/yukon8b/4923456789/report.html

Mara: Quick findings from the profile:
- p99 at 520ms driven by kvcache evictions at sequence boundaries
- batch=8 shows amplification of GC-style stalls
- throughput steady-state ≈240 tok/s per GPU at batch=4
Flamegraph: https://internal.artifacts/redwood/yukon8b/4923456789/flame.svg

Sophia: Suggestion: try disabling tiling + increase batch_slots to 64. Config I used for a rerun:
```
runtime.conf:
  kvcache_tiling: false
  kvcache_eviction: LRU
  batch_slots: 64
```

Mara: Reran with that config on same cluster. New numbers (seq128, batch1): median=145ms, p95=300ms, p99=460ms. Tail reduced but memory usage +8%. Throughput with batch=4 improved to ~260 tok/s.

Jia: Thanks — can we prepare a canary plan? Proposal: canary in eu-west with 5% traffic on dedicated pool, fallback to yukon-8b-quant-v2 if latency regression > 10% sustained for 2m. Also require smoke in eu-west.

ops-rotation: Canary scheduled for Mon 2026-03-23 09:30 PT in eu-west. Will enable spike alarms and latency p99 alerting.

Evan: Action items:
- Mara: upload raw perf logs to /artifacts/yukon8b/4923456789 (include perf counters)
- Sophia: open PR with runtime config diff and test matrix
- Jia: draft canary policy + rollback thresholds
- Ops: run eu-west smoke and monitor
I'll sync on progress tomorrow 10:00am PT. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Mara: Uploaded logs and perf counters: gs://redwood-artifacts/yukon8b/4923456789/

Sophia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8234 — includes test scripts and tiling toggle.
